title: Starterpack smoke checks and triage — Aug 06 2026
content:
Context: quick, narrow sprint checkpoint to ship a minimal "starter pack" for new SDK users (node/python) — covers quickstart, one sample app, and CI smoke checks. Goal for this week: unblock publishing and get basic telemetry + docs accuracy verified before public rollout.

Attendees: Lena, Ethan, Maya, Rahul, (drop-ins: Priya for release questions)

Agenda:
- Status of quickstart README + code samples
- Smoke test failures observed in CI (flaky end-to-end tests)
- Docs copy vs. actual behavior (auth/ENV mismatch)
- Rollout checklist and release gating items

Notes / Observations:
- README drift: examples show REDWOOD_API_KEY env but our SDK now accepts REDWOOD_KEY alias. Confusing for first-time users. Proposed: update README + add compatibility note and small wrapper that reads both env vars. (Ethan)
- Python sample app: uses deprecated reply_stream API shape; triggers warning in logs and causes trace mismatch in sample telemetry. Need to patch sample to new streaming callback signature. (Maya)
- Node quickstart: npm install installs optional dev-native deps on ARM CI runners -> timeouts. We should pin optionalDependencies in package.json for CI or add OS check. (Rahul)
- CI smoke: two intermittent failures in e2e: one due to API key rotation mock not stubbing properly (test harness), second due to rate limiter default (local CI ephemeral tokens exceeded). Short-term fix: increase local rate limit for smoke job and add retry harness. Long-term: add deterministic fixture for auth layer. (Lena)
- Telemetry: starterpack telemetry events missing "starter_version" property which breaks dashboard filters. Small bug: telemetry helper reading package.json wrong key. Quick fix in helper, release patch. (Ethan)

Decisions made:
- Ship patch for README and add compatibility note today. File: docs/quickstarts/starterpack-readme.md -> PR to starterpacks repo. (owner: Ethan)
- Update python sample to new streaming signature and add unit that asserts correct callback invocation. (owner: Maya)
- Add CI job tweak to skip optional native deps on ARM runners; create follow-up ticket to improve cross-arch dev deps. (owner: Rahul)
- Telemetry helper patch to include starter_version and a test asserting event shape. Release as 0.3.1. (owner: Ethan)
- Release gating: unblock on README + python sample fix + telemetry patch. Node CI tweak can be merged after gating as it's lower risk.

Action items (with tentative due dates):
- Ethan: PR starterpack README compatibility note + small env wrapper (due 2026-08-06 EOD) [PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starterpacks/pull/412] 
- Maya: Patch python sample streaming API + add unit test (due 2026-08-07) [JIRA DEVEXP-987] 
- Rahul: Add CI job flag to skip optional native deps on ARM and document in contributor guide (due 2026-08-07) 
- Lena: Create fixture plan for auth layer (spike) and add to backlog (due 2026-08-10) 
- Priya: Validate release checklist items for telemetry and permissions ahead of release candidate (due 2026-08-07)

Blockers / Risks:
- If python streaming fix slips, we cannot publicize starterpack because telemetry and sample logs will produce confusing errors for new users.
- Telemetry mismatch currently causes dashboards to drop events; that would make early rollout monitoring blind. High priority.
- ARM CI flakiness could delay merges if we don't skip optional deps; moderate risk.

Follow-ups / Notes to self:
- Add a quick note in the console docs about env var aliases and deprecation schedule for REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY (PM alignment needed).
- Consider adding a tiny local starterpack smoke script (one-liner) that runs the quickstart locally with a mock endpoint to verify basic flow — lower friction for contributors and field engineers.
- Add contributor checklist to repo: node/python matrix, env var compatibility, telemetry event spec.

Quick wins for today:
- Publish README PR (Ethan)
- Telemetry helper patch + unit (Ethan)
- Node CI skip optional deps (Rahul)

Reference snippets (for PRs):
- env wrapper idea (pseudo):
  const key = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || ''

- telemetry event spec reminder:
  { event: 'starter_init', starter_version: '0.3.1', lang: 'python' }

Meeting adjourned — next quick sync Tue 2026-08-10 10:00PT (15m) to verify gating items merged and CI green.

Notes: rough, please edit/clean up in PR description before merging into confluence. This doc is intended as a lightweight log for the release owners and triage attendees.
